payload.summary: next dev is OOM-killed after compiling roughly 55-60 routes in sequence
payload.detail: Reproduced three times at ~13.6 GB RSS in a 16 GB container, each time around the same point in a sequential route sweep; a --max-old-space-size cap did not help. The visual audit had to build and serve production instead. Not a product defect, but it costs anyone doing sustained local work across many routes, and a whole sweep going blank looks like an app failure (the 2026-08-06 audit recorded exactly that misreading).
